facts.text: Lost and found: RST Video next door.
facts.why: In Clerks III Jay and Silent Bob have taken over the former RST Video and turned it into a legal marijuana dispensary, so RST Video is not next door any more.
facts.fix: Jay and Silent Bob next door

facts.why: Same as the footer. The former RST Video is now Jay and Silent Bob's dispensary.
facts.fix: Jay and Silent Bob next door

facts.text: Randal's new heart-healthy diet after the heart attack.
facts.why: After the heart attack the doctor tells Dante to get Randal eating vegetables, and Dante says he will only order him from the vegan menu at Mooby's.

facts.text: Randal's new diet since the heart attack. He hates it.
facts.why: The doctor's vegetable advice is in the film, but nothing shows tea as part of it or Randal hating it.
facts.fix: Iced tea for the man who just had a heart attack.
